correctness.rationale: Independent enumeration of all 5005 nine-edge subsets using graph edges between disjoint 2-subsets of [5] found exactly 2000 acyclic spanning subsets. Own integer 32768-point Walsh transform gave all 12 absolute bins including 13912 zeros, gcd/gap 16, exact rank 18856, inverse support-kernel absolute numerator 1172832, Parseval. A general averaged-conjugate projection proof is sound: for any projection Q onto a translation-invariant range E, translation average still maps into E and is identity on E, hence is the unique translation-invariant spectral support projection. Norm convexity plus translation isometries show it is globally optimal over all real/complex projections. Quotient 1172832/32768=36651/1024. The package independently specifies weighted-Laplacian determinants on all signings and 396 S5 automorphism orbits; independent full Walsh enumeration verifies the critical numerical claim without depending on saved logs.
